snippet.title: Synergy - Official Full Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Synergy is officially out of Early Access!🌿

V1.0 is now available on Steam, GOG, and the Epic Games Store with a 24% launch discount. 
Experience the full game with a brand-new campaign, an exploration overhaul and lots of exciting new content!

Play Synergy v1.0 on:
- Steam: https://tinyurl.com/Synergy-ytst
- GOG: https://tinyurl.com/Synergy-GG
- Epic Games Store: https://tinyurl.com/Synergy-EPC

#synergy #gaming #citybuilder #indiegame
